packageRules.description: One weekly PR for minor and patch Rust crate updates. Majors stay separate, and security fixes still come right away.

The toolchain follows each new stable Rust, and the crates support the release before it. On a minor bump, the same PR fixes new clippy lints and raises the workspace rust-version to the release the toolchain leaves.
prBodyNotes: On a minor bump, fix new clippy lints in this PR and raise the workspace `rust-version` in `Cargo.toml` to the release the toolchain leaves: for 1.100.0 → 1.101.0, set `1.100`. A patch bump needs neither.
